model_notes.Gemma 4: Apache-2.0. Variants: E2B, E4B, 12B Unified (11.95B dense), 26B-A4B MoE, 31B dense. Released 2026-04-02 (HF blog). vLLM architectures Gemma4ForCausalLM and Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration.
model_notes.Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: 30B-A3B hybrid Mamba-2 + attention MoE, OpenMDW-1.1 license, ~2026-08-11. NemotronH family architecture; BF16 + NVFP4 (W4A16 on Hopper/Ampere) checkpoints.
model_notes.Nemotron Nano 9B v2: Mamba-2/MLP + 4 attention layers hybrid; NVIDIA Open Model License; released 2025-08-18.
model_notes.Granite 4.2: DENSE transformer 3B/8B/30B, Apache-2.0, released 2026-08-25 (IBM HF card). Not Mamba-hybrid, so it uses standard Granite arch.
model_notes.Qwen3.8: Apache-2.0 (27B dense card checked); hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention, shared design since Qwen3-Next/3.5.
model_notes.Phi-4: Phi3ForCausalLM architecture; MIT license (prior knowledge, UNVERIFIED this session).

matrix.detail: Docs table lists Gemma4ForCausalLM + Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration, LoRA yes. Recipes: E2B/E4B/12B/31B/26B-A4B; W4A16 QAT checkpoints; 31B dense needs >=80GB on NVIDIA. Red Hat day-0 guide 2026-04-02.

NemotronHForCausalLM (LoRA yes); Lightning not named separately in table but model card says vLLM primary; single H100 256K ctx BF16. Mamba ReplaySSM/MTP work Sep 2026. Hybrid prefix-cache needs special flag.
vLLM >=0.10.1, use --mamba_ssm_cache_dtype float32.

GptOssForCausalLM LoRA yes. Recipe covers H100/H200/B200/A100 (Ampere via TRITON_ATTN). L4/RTX PRO 6000 not named in recipe.

Phi3ForCausalLM LoRA yes.
